title: Callsigns
description: Generation callsigns, generic list and (optional) deeds (spec MGT-013..MGT-020).
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

generic.description: MGT-014: names used when no attribute is 40 or above

tieMargin.description: MGT-013, design 5: every attribute within tieMargin of the highest is a candidate

deeds.description: MGT-017 (optional): each deed is earned at most once per soldier (MGT-018); a used-up list keeps the current callsign (MGT-015)
